recentItems.title: Why Kate Hudson Is Hesitant About Danny Fujikawa Wedding | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kate Hudson isn't ready to live out bride wars IRL. Despite getting engaged to Danny Fujikawa in 2021, the ‘Almost Famous’ star explained one reason she's not looking forward to wedding planning: the price tag. "That's part of why I don't want to get married—it's too expensive," she shared on the Sept. 8 episode of her ‘Sibling Revelrey’ podcast. "I just want hors d'oeuvres. I wanna do, like, chips and salsa." The Oscar nominee also pointed to the pressures of figuring out who gets an invite—and who doesn’t make the cut—as another detractor against making it down the aisle. However, the ‘Song Sung Blue’ actress has made it clear that she has no apprehension when it comes to her love for Fujikawa. Hudson told Women’s Health in 2019, "I've got the best man… It's the first time I feel like I have a real teammate in this.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435904/why-kate-hudson-not-married-after-danny-fujikawa-engagement

recentItems.title: See Mary-Kate Olsen and Ashley Olsen’s Low-Key NYC Appearance | E! News
recentItems.description:
Mary-Kate Olsen and Ashley Olsen stepped out together in New York City, giving fans a rare look at the famously private twins’ signature coordinated style ahead of Fashion Week. The 40-year-old former Full House stars, who began playing Michelle Tanner in 1987, stepped away from acting in 2012 to focus on their luxury fashion label, The Row. Their outing came just over four months after they were photographed together following an April 30 lunch in NYC. Full House creator Jeff Franklin recently told People their acting was “on another level,” recalling a then-one-year-old Olsen twin nailing a minutes-long scene in the episode where Uncle Jesse is an Elvis impersonator.

recentItems.title: Jennifer Lawrence Joins Instagram in the Most Jennifer Lawrence Way | E! News
recentItems.description:
Jennifer Lawrence has entered the world of slideshows and Close Friends Only stories. The Oscar-winning actress officially joined Instagram Sep. 9 under the handle @jlaw—because according to her bio, her original choice of @jenniferlawrence was already taken. Lawrence has previously indicated that she purposefully avoids certain corners of social media. However, she revealed in a Nov. 2025 interview with Robert Pattinson that she also has a secret TikTok account that she uses to “get in fights in the comments section.”

recentItems.title: Nicolas Cage’s Malibu Mansion Nearly Collapses | E! News
recentItems.description:
A growing sinkhole in the driveway of Nicolas Cage’s—who wed his wife Riko Shibata in 2021—oceanfront Malibu home has caused officials to declare a local emergency and issue evacuation orders for 31 nearby residences. In photos taken of the property, orange traffic cones sit in front of the hole where asphalt and concrete appear to have simply cracked open and fallen in. recentItems.title: Lindsay Clancy’s Lawyer BLASTS “Horrific” Theories About Patrick Clancy | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kevin Reddington is standing by the Clancy family. While navigating the next steps for his client Lindsay Clancy after her case ended in a mistrial on Sept. 4 over a deadlocked jury, the attorney is defending Lindsay's ex-husband Patrick Clancy from online theories that have emerged. Among them includes the allegation he was somehow involved in the murders of his and Lindsay’s three children in 2023—deaths Lindsay admitted to carrying out before attempting to take her own life. “The man ought to be able to move on with his life,” Reddington stated during a Sep. 9 interview with CBS Mornings, “and stop with the speculation and horrific conspiracy allegations that he was involved with some massive conspiracy to kill his children.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435882/lindsay-clancys-lawyer-slams-conspiracies-about-patrick-clancy
